summary: Iteration-12 — crypto deposit auto-verify (CoinGecko-priced on-chain credit, per-coin toggle, USDT_BEP20 new). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_crypto_autoverify.py — 5/5 pass. (1) GET /api/admin/settings exposes auto_verify for BTC/USDT_TRC20/USDT_BEP20/LTC/ETH with default confirmations 2/20/15/6/12 and enabled=true. (2) PUT /api/admin/settings {auto_verify:{BTC:{enabled:false,confirmations:3}}} persists via re-GET and is restored. (3) GET /api/wallet/coins contains USDT_BEP20 with network 'BEP20 (BNB Smart Chain)'. (4) E2E BTC auto-credit against a REAL mainnet tx (mempool.space blocks[3] -> block/{hash}/txids -> tx/{txid} vout scriptpubkey_address): admin BTC address set to the real output addr, buyer created deposit + submitted real txid, within ~10s deposit.status flipped pending->approved with auto=true, chain.state=credited, chain.required/confirmations present, credited_cents == received_amount * live_usd_price * 100 (±2 rounding), buyer balance incremented by exactly credited_cents, admin pending queue no longer contains the deposit, audit log has 'deposit.auto_approve' entry on the deposit id. Afterwards the original BTC address was restored and the credited amount was debited back from the buyer via POST /api/admin/users/{uid}/adjust so buyer balance == original. (5) Mismatch flow: BTC address temporarily switched to a BIP173 test-vector address, same real tx re-used — chain.state=mismatch, chain.final=true, status stays 'pending' AND the deposit appears in /api/admin/deposits?status=pending; POST /api/admin/deposits/{id}/recheck returns 200 and chain.state is 'mismatch'; manual reject sets status=rejected and chain.final=true. (6) Manual-approve-stops-autocheck: fresh BTC deposit with random non-existent txid submitted (chain.state=searching), admin POST /api/admin/deposits/{id}/approve returns status=approved, chain.final=true, auto!=true (not auto), balance incremented by the approved $1 (then rolled back). Frontend (Playwright 1920x1080, real admin/buyer logins via math captcha from GET /api/auth/captcha): Admin > Commission & wallets — auto-verify-settings card renders, auto-verify-toggle-{BTC,USDT_TRC20,USDT_BEP20,LTC,ETH} checkboxes + auto-verify-conf-{...} number inputs are present, auto-verify-save-btn triggers 'Auto-verify settings saved' toast and persists (ETH confirmations round-trip verified in UI); address-input-USDT_BEP20 is rendered inside the addresses card. Wallet page — deposit-coin-select includes 'Tether (USDT) — BEP20 (BNB Smart Chain)'; existing auto-credited deposits display 'Confirmed on-chain · auto-credited' with 'received 0.86654997 BTC @ $82,782' line (ChainStatus component); after submitting a random fake TXID the toast 'TXID submitted — waiting for network confirmation. Your balance updates automatically once confirmed.' is shown and the new pending row shows deposit-chain-{id} with 'Looking for your transaction on the network…'. Admin > Add-fund requests — admin-dep-chain-{id} shows 'Looking for your transaction on the network…' for pending auto-check deposits, dep-recheck-{id} refresh button is clickable and triggers an API call; approved filter shows the AUTO-VERIFIED label alongside status + the ChainStatus confirmed line + received amount @ CoinGecko price for each auto-credited deposit.
critical_code_review_comments: chain.process_deposit (chain.py:148) credits via two sequential updates (deposits find_one_and_update then users $inc). If the users $inc mongo op fails after the deposit flips to approved, the balance never gets credited while the deposit shows approved — orphaned credit. Consider wrapping both in a session.start_transaction() or using a 2-phase 'pending_credit' guard field, or at least logging+retrying when the second write errors.

poll_loop (chain.py:209) catches every exception and sleeps 60s — if get_settings returns malformed auto_verify (e.g. during migration) the loop silently stalls on every tick with just a warning log. A circuit-break counter + health gauge would help ops.

submit_txid (server.py:558) lowercases the txid unconditionally — fine for hex (BTC/LTC/ETH/BEP20/TRC20) but if any future coin uses a case-sensitive representation (e.g. mixed-case Base58 for XRP) this is lossy. Keep the lowercase constraint explicitly in the coin's parser only.

chain.check_eth (chain.py:78) requires `tx.input in ('0x','',None)` to count as native transfer — correct, but it rejects native transfers that originated from a contract that forwarded ETH (0-amount input but non-empty data). Low-impact for direct user deposits but worth noting.

ChainStatus.jsx renders only when d.chain?.state exists AND (status=='pending' OR state=='credited') — this means a rejected deposit with chain.state=='mismatch' hides its chain error in the buyer wallet (buyers see only reason). Admin view also hides it after reject. OK but inconsistent with pending-mismatch rows.

chain.verify_now is spawned via asyncio.create_task without being tracked; if the FastAPI worker is cycled right after submit_txid returns, that one check is lost (the 60s poll loop would still pick it up next tick, so impact is low).

No per-user rate limit on /wallet/deposits/{did}/txid — a buyer could spam real txids against many pre-created deposit docs. Explorer calls are shared across pods; consider a token-bucket on txid submits.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin settings auto-verify UI, address-input-USDT_BEP20, wallet deposit coin incl. USDT_BEP20, submit-txid toast + chain status, admin dep-recheck + admin-dep-chain, auto-verified label on approved — all pass)

seed_data_creation: Deposits created by tests: 1 approved BTC deposit (auto-credited then debited back via /api/admin/users/{uid}/adjust so buyer balance_cents unchanged), 1 pending->rejected BTC deposit (mismatch cleanup), 1 pending->approved BTC deposit (manual approve then $1.00 debit via adjust so balance unchanged), 1 leftover pending BTC deposit from frontend fake-txid test was rejected post-test via /api/admin/deposits/{id}/reject with reason 'TEST iter12 cleanup'. BTC deposit address was temporarily swapped and restored under try/finally in both affected tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-verify runs via chain.poll_loop every 60s and inline chain.verify_now after submit_txid. settings.auto_verify holds {COIN:{enabled,confirmations}} with defaults BTC=2 / USDT_TRC20=20 / USDT_BEP20=15 (new) / LTC=6 / ETH=12, enabled=true. Deposit lifecycle: awaiting_txid -> (submit) pending w/ chain.state=searching -> process_deposit sets state in {searching,checking,confirming,credited,mismatch,failed,not_found}; credited flips status=approved + sets auto=true + reviewed_by='auto-verify' + chain.final=true and $inc balance. Admin manual approve/reject also sets chain.final=true (poller skips chain.final!=true in query). POST /api/admin/deposits/{id}/recheck forces chain.final=false and calls process_deposit synchronously. Each real txid is unique-indexed in Mongo — don't reuse a txid across tests. Frontend testids: auto-verify-settings, auto-verify-toggle-{COIN}, auto-verify-conf-{COIN}, auto-verify-save-btn, address-input-{COIN} (incl USDT_BEP20), deposit-coin-select, deposit-amount-input, deposit-continue-btn, deposit-txid-input, deposit-submit-txid-btn, deposit-chain-{id} (buyer wallet), admin-dep-chain-{id}, dep-recheck-{id}, dep-approve-{id}, dep-reject-{id}. ChainStatus labels (chain.state -> UI): searching->'Looking for your transaction on the network…', confirming->'Waiting for network confirmations' + N/M counter + progress bar, credited->'Confirmed on-chain · auto-credited', mismatch/failed/not_found->'Needs manual review'. Admin section nav is /admin?s=deposits (not a visible 'Deposits' button — uses admin-jump select on toolbar or admin tiles on home).
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. All spec items verified against real mainnet data (mempool.space) with a successful live BTC auto-credit at ~$82,793/BTC and matching credited_cents. Code review notes above are non-blocking enhancements.
